title: NVIDIA Grace Hopper Superchip Sweeps MLPerf Inference Benchmarks
description: In its debut on the MLPerf industry benchmarks, the NVIDIA GH200 Grace Hopper Superchip ran all data center inference tests, extending the leading performance of NVIDIA H100 Tensor Core GPUs.
